answer: At a market jetty, agents must post a jade-denominated bond before their votes or deliveries count. A lantern checkpoint every epoch publishes all signatures, and any agent caught countersigning conflicting ballots has its bond burned. Voting weight equals bonded capital, never account count, so splitting one deposit across a thousand fake agents buys zero influence. Attackers must immobilize fresh collateral per identity and risk total slash, turning cheap sybils into a capital loss.
